title: maint.event.v1{kind=allowlist_show}
description: Phase 8 §8.1 / §8.7 — operator queries the active pattern_allowlist surface. The CLI does NOT read PG directly (§8.1 'no bypass channels'); instead the consumer (maint.sec.v1, lands in §8.7) responds with the matching rows in `maint.ack.v1.details.rows[]` (capped per §8.15.5 details budget; oversize → operator narrows the filter or queries the audit table out-of-band). `target` is a filter expression: 'all' (everything; bounded by the consumer's max-row cap), '<source>' (single source), or '<source>:<rule_id>' (single row).

include_expired.description: When true, include rows in state='e' (expired). Default false (active only).
